steps.name: Validate approval, final tag and durable manifest destination
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
version=$(jq -r .version "$BUNDLE/build-manifest.json")
[[ "$version" =~ ^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$ ]]
tag=$("$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/release_tag.py" --manifest "$BUNDLE/build-manifest.json")
source_sha=$(jq -r .source.sha "$BUNDLE/build-manifest.json")
object=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/ref/tags/$tag" --jq .object)
for _ in {1..10}; do
  [[ $(jq -r .type <<< "$object") == tag ]] || break
  object=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/git/tags/$(jq -r .sha <<< "$object")" --jq .object)
done
[[ $(jq -r .type <<< "$object") == commit && $(jq -r .sha <<< "$object") == "$source_sha" ]]
gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/approvals" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/approvals.json"
jq -n --arg environment "$ENVIRONMENT" '[
  {name:"nexus-username",ref:("environment:"+$environment+"/NEXUS_PUBLISH_USERNAME")},
  {name:"nexus-password",ref:("environment:"+$environment+"/NEXUS_PUBLISH_PASSWORD")}
]' > "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-configuration.json"
"$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/deploy_record.py" --bundle "$BUNDLE" --manifest-sha256 "$EXPECTED_HASH" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --environment "$ENVIRONMENT" \
  --destination "$NEXUS_URL/repository/maven-releases" --previous-manifest "$PREVIOUS" \
  --approvals "$RUNNER_TEMP/approvals.json" --configuration "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-configuration.json" \
  --result failed --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.json"
"$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/release_manifest.py" --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --tag "$tag" \
  --manifest-sha256 "$EXPECTED_HASH" --bundle "$BUNDLE"
echo "tag=$tag" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Promote exactly the verified Maven files
Retain the signed build manifest before publishing the final release
Signed deployment outcome from the approved build
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
result=failed
if [[ "$PROMOTION" == success && ("$RETENTION" == success || "$RETENTION" == skipped) ]]; then result=succeeded; fi
"$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/deploy_record.py" --bundle "$BUNDLE" --manifest-sha256 "$EXPECTED_HASH" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --environment "$ENVIRONMENT" \
  --destination "$NEXUS_URL/repository/maven-releases" --previous-manifest "$PREVIOUS" \
  --approvals "$RUNNER_TEMP/approvals.json" --configuration "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-configuration.json" \
  --result "$result" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.json"
cosign sign-blob --yes --bundle "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.sigstore.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.json"

steps.name: Durable deployment audit
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'Build manifest: %s\nProducer commit: %s\n' "$HASH" "$SOURCE_SHA" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-notes.txt"
gh release create "deploy/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" \
  "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.sigstore.json" \
  --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --target "$SOURCE_SHA" --prerelease --latest=false \
  --title "Deployment $GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" --notes-file "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-notes.txt"

steps.name: Verify immutable registry content, values and environment approval
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
if [[ -n "$EXPECTED_GITOPS" && "$EXPECTED_GITOPS" != "$GITOPS" ]]; then
  echo "GitOps destination differs from the predecessor observed before promotion" >&2
  exit 1
fi
mkdir -p "$DOCKER_CONFIG" "$(dirname "$HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG")"
chmod 700 "$DOCKER_CONFIG" "$(dirname "$HELM_REGISTRY_CONFIG")"
mapfile -t registries < <(jq -r '[.artifacts.image.repository,.artifacts.chart.oci|sub("^oci://";"")|split("/")[0]]|unique[]' "$BUNDLE/build-manifest.json")
for registry in "${registries[@]}"; do
  printf '%s' "$PASSWORD" | docker login "$registry" --username "$USERNAME" --password-stdin
  printf '%s' "$PASSWORD" | helm registry login "$registry" --username "$USERNAME" --password-stdin
done
"$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/service_deploy.py" --bundle "$BUNDLE" --manifest-sha256 "$HASH" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --environment "$ENVIRONMENT" --values-revision "$VALUES_REVISION" \
  --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/prepared-deployment.json" --configuration "$RUNNER_TEMP/values-refs.json"
jq --arg environment "$ENVIRONMENT" --arg gitops "$GITOPS" --arg branch "$BRANCH" '. + [
  {name:"gitops-destination",ref:("https://github.com/"+$gitops+"/tree/"+$branch)},
  {name:"gitops-app",ref:("environment:"+$environment+"/GITOPS_APP_ID")},
  {name:"gitops-app-key",ref:("environment:"+$environment+"/GITOPS_APP_PRIVATE_KEY")},
  {name:"argocd-read-token",ref:("environment:"+$environment+"/ARGOCD_AUTH_TOKEN")}
]' "$RUNNER_TEMP/values-refs.json" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-configuration.json"
gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID/approvals" > "$RUNNER_TEMP/approvals.json"
"$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/deploy_record.py" --bundle "$BUNDLE" --manifest-sha256 "$HASH" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --environment "$ENVIRONMENT" --destination "https://github.com/$GITOPS" \
  --previous-manifest "$PREVIOUS" --approvals "$RUNNER_TEMP/approvals.json" \
  --configuration "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-configuration.json" --result requested --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-request.json"
cosign sign-blob --yes --bundle "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-request.sigstore.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-request.json"
echo "request-sha256=$(sha256sum "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-request.json" | cut -d' ' -f1)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

steps.name: Commit approved digests and signed request to GitOps
Confirm Argo CD applied the approved immutable sources
Sign deployment outcome
steps.run:
set -euo pipefail
result=failed
if [[ "$HEALTH" == success ]]; then result=succeeded; fi
"$PYTHON" "$TOOLS/deploy_record.py" --bundle "$BUNDLE" --manifest-sha256 "$HASH" \
  --repository "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --environment "$ENVIRONMENT" --destination "https://github.com/$GITOPS" \
  --previous-manifest "$PREVIOUS" --approvals "$RUNNER_TEMP/approvals.json" \
  --configuration "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-configuration.json" --result "$result" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.json"
cosign sign-blob --yes --bundle "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.sigstore.json" "$RUNNER_TEMP/deploy-record.json"
